classification.difficultyReason: Construct disjoint, overlapping and nested Venn diagrams from listed sets, then identify their unions and intersections.

content.prompt: For each part, draw a Venn diagram, then list $A\cup B$ and $A\cap B$.

answer.worked:
The sets have no common elements, so draw two separate circles. Place $1,2,4$ inside $A$ and $3,5$ inside $B$.

$$\begin{align*}A\cup B&=\{1,2,3,4,5\}\\A\cap B&=\varnothing\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two disjoint circles A and B inside E; no additional universal-set elements are specified.
spec.mathematics: A contains 1, 2, 4; B contains 3, 5; intersection is empty.

answer.worked:
Place the common elements $e,i$ in the overlap, $a$ in $A$ only, and $o,s,t$ in $B$ only. The union contains every element in either circle.

$$\begin{align*}A\cup B&=\{a,e,i,o,s,t\}\\A\cap B&=\{e,i\}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Overlapping circles with a in A only, e and i in the intersection, and o, s, t in B only.

answer.worked:
Every element of $B$ belongs to $A$, so draw circle $B$ inside circle $A$. Place $3,8,10$ inside $B$ and $1,2,5$ inside $A$ but outside $B$.

$$\begin{align*}A\cup B&=\{1,2,3,5,8,10\}\\A\cap B&=\{3,8,10\}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Circle B wholly inside A; 3, 8, 10 inside B and 1, 2, 5 in the remainder of A.
spec.mathematics: B is a subset of A; union equals A and intersection equals B.
